description.p: Tern is a mail app in the style of Apple Mail: mailboxes, messages and the open message side by side, with conversations, search, flags and quick keyboard shortcuts.

It works with iCloud, Gmail (with an app password), Fastmail and any IMAP and SMTP server, keeps a local copy for fast search and offline reading, and keeps passwords in your desktop's keyring. Remote content in messages is blocked until you allow it.
